feeds.title: Triangle Gardener Magazine
feeds.description: Triangle Gardener is North Carolina's leader in gardening news and information, including a print magazine, website, and a podcast - all about gardening!

feeds.title: Sow True Seed Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2008 by lifelong gardener and food activist Carol Koury, Sow True Seed was created to preserve our shared botanical heritage and grow a new era of ecological wisdom. We are a small, dedicated staff of dirt worshippers committed to providing high quality, open-pollinated seeds in support of sustainable food production and regenerative agriculture.

feeds.title: Green Biz Nursery Blog
feeds.description: Follow Green Biz's gardening tips blog to know more about what's best for your garden. Green Biz has been a leader in the greater Fayetteville, NC area in landscaping and plant care since its inception in 1979.

feeds.title: Green Side Up Garden
feeds.description: Green Side Up Gift and Garden Center is a family-owned and operated gift and garden center located in Fayetteville North Carolina. Read Green Side Up Garden's What's Blooming to know everything thing about gardening and how it is done with the help of the articles filled with all the necessary tips.

feeds.title: WALTER Magazine » Home & Garden
feeds.description: The following section of the Walter Magazine is dedicated to home & gardening. WALTER covers the art, culture and people of Raleigh, North Carolina through 10 print issues annually and exclusive online content.

feeds.title: Extension Master Gardener Volunteers of Durham County
feeds.description: This blog is updated by Extension Master Gardener Volunteers (EMGV) from Durham County, NC. Our goal is to provide research-based gardening information to the public.

feeds.title: Garden Valley Market Blog
feeds.description: This space is to inspire you to plant better, eat better, and live better. We give unique tips and tricks on growing your very best garden flower, vegetables, herbs, and shrubs. And we provide mouth watering recipes for you and your family to make and enjoy all year long! At Garden Valley Farmers Market, we strive to provide our customers with the best quality and selection of homegrown produce and plants available throughout the year.

feeds.title: Buncombe County Master Gardener
feeds.description: As Extension Master Gardener volunteers (EMGVs), we are part of a vast national Cooperative Extension system that seeks to help individuals, families and communities put research based knowledge to work in their lives. Our mission is to support, teach and encourage a diverse community of gardeners using current research-based horticulture practices.

feeds.title: Brie Grows Blog
feeds.description: Author, professional horticulturist and lifelong gardener, Brie Arthur is on a mission to cultivate green thumb confidence by sharing practical advice about growing all of your favorite plants.

feeds.title: Mitchells Nursery and Greenhouse Blog
feeds.description: Experts gardening tips to ensure your plants reach their maximum potential. Mitchell's Nursery & Greenhouse is a local, family-owned business with a knowledgeable staff on-site to answer all of your plant questions. Located in King, NC, just north of Winston-Salem, they sell to landscapers, contractors, florists, garden centers, and the public.

feeds.title: The Pitt County Arboretum Blog
feeds.description: From how to get rid of animals which are not safe for your garden to what time is the best to grown a certain plant, all can be found in The Pitt County Arboretum's blog. The 7-acre Arboretum surrounding the Pitt County Agricultural Center shows what you can do in your home garden.

feeds.title: Fifth Season Gardening Blog
feeds.description: Fifth Season Gardening is offering hydroponics, fresh hops & homebrew supplies, organic gardening soil & seeds, canna, cheese-making and urban DIY in North Carolina & Virginia. Fifth Season Gardening Company began in 2000 with the opening of Asheville Agricultural Systems in Asheville, NC, followed by stores in Durham, NC in 2002 and Greensboro, NC in 2004, both under the Carolina Hydrogardens name.

feeds.title: Fairview Garden Center Blog
feeds.description: Our seasoned gardening experts here at Fairview Garden Center are happy to share gardening tips & how-to's on our plant & flower blog. For more than 40 years, Fairview Garden Center has provided exceptional plants and flowers in Raleigh, NC and across the Triangle area.

feeds.title: Wing Haven Blog
feeds.description: Located in the heart of Charlotte, North Carolina, Wing Haven provides a natural oasis for reflection and study of its three public gardens.

feeds.title: Our State » Home & Garden
feeds.description: The following section of Our State is dedicated to home and gardening. Our State Magazine is North Carolina's premier statewide magazine devoted to travel, history, people and places.

feeds.title: Natural Gardening
feeds.description: I'm Lisa. I'm a lifelong teacher, nature-lover, gardener, writer, and traveler. My first blog, Natural Gardening, reflects gardening and nature experiences over the last decade.

feeds.title: The Citrus Guy
feeds.description: Darren Sheriff is a Certified Professional Nurseryman, Master Gardener and works at a nursery. He loves working with other gardeners and plant problem solving.

feeds.title: Outside Clyde
feeds.description: Living the life of gardening high on the low spot of a North Carolina mountaintop.

feeds.title: Microfarm Organic Gardens Blog
feeds.description: Organic edible gardening and micro-farming news, tips, tricks and updates. Microfarm Organic Gardens is a family owned company devoted solely to organic edible gardening.

feeds.title: Carolina Tree
feeds.description: Carolina Tree is the leading tree care provider in the Greater Charlotte, NC area, specializing in tree pruning, tree removal, plant health care (PHC), and emergency response. Follow this blog to get in depth knowledge on tree pruning, tree removal and much more.

feeds.title: Carolina Seasons Nursery Blog
feeds.description: Carolina Seasons Nursery is a ten acre nursery nestled off of 903 North in Greenville, NC. We are dedicated to quality plant production while maintaining a diverse selection of plants and providing knowledgeable customer service.

feeds.title: North Carolina Farms Inc
feeds.description: A family-owned wholesale starter plant company providing rooted plugs and unrooted cuttings to greenhouses and garden centers all over North America.

feeds.title: Carolina Country » Carolina Gardens
feeds.description: Seasonal tips from our gardening expert. Carolina Country is the monthly magazine of North Carolina's electric cooperatives.

feeds.title: Organic Growers School Blog
feeds.description: Organic Growers School is the premiere provider of practical and affordable organic education in the Southern Appalachians, building a vibrant food & farming community by boosting the success of organic home growers and farmers in our region. Our hands-on training, workshops, conferences and partnerships strengthen and celebrate each grower's move towards self-reliance.
